covers: The Wall Street open and the JSE afternoon session, Monday 16 November 2026
headline: Nasdaq opens 2.1% lower as chip stocks slide; Nvidia down 2.7% to $158.70 a day before results
summary: On the JSE, Telkom was up 15.1% at R71.35 and MTN down 2.3% at R229.16 just before 15:00 after the two confirmed early takeover talks, while the All Share was 0.5% lower at 111,800 at 14:15 and the rand near R17/$ (TechCentral, 16 Nov 2026; LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 16 Nov 2026 14:15 SAST). Wall Street opened mixed, with the Nasdaq down 2.1%, the S&P 500 down 0.8% and the Dow down 0.2%, as Nvidia fell 2.7% to $158.70 and AMD 5.1% after Jensen Huang's resignation as CEO last week (City AM, 16 Nov 2026 14:38 GMT). Gold traded around $3,869 near a one-year low and Brent around $95 as the dollar stayed strong and markets priced a December Fed hike, which keeps pressure on the rand ahead of SA CPI on Wednesday and the SARB decision on Thursday (Yahoo Finance, 16 Nov 2026; Reuters via CNBC Africa, 16 Nov 2026).

items.title: Nasdaq opens 2.1% lower; Nvidia -2.7% to $158.70, AMD -5.1%, Intel -5.7%
items.summary: US markets opened mixed: the S&P 500 fell 0.8%, the Dow 0.2% and the Nasdaq Composite 2.1%. Nvidia slipped to $158.70 in early trade, from Friday's $162.80, and is 32% below its October peak; AMD fell 5.1% and Broadcom 4.2%, reversing last week's gains. City AM links the pressure to fallout from Jensen Huang's resignation as CEO last Thursday and reports that he is weighing a comeback; interim CEO Colette Kress presents results on Tuesday 17 November.
items.source: City AM, 16 Nov 2026 14:38 GMT; Yahoo Finance live blog, 16 Nov 2026 06:25 PST

items.title: Futures pointed lower before the open; Asia fell overnight
items.summary: Before the open, S&P 500 futures were down 0.7% and Nasdaq-100 futures down 1.5%, with crypto-linked shares 5-8% lower in pre-market trade as bitcoin fell to about $64,000. Japan's Nikkei 225 fell 2.4% to 59,662.02 and Korea's Kospi 3.6%. Last week the three main US indices each gained more than 2%.
items.source: Yahoo Finance live blog, 16 Nov 2026 06:25 PST; AP via BNN Bloomberg, 16 Nov 2026 06:48 EST; TipRanks, 16 Nov 2026

items.title: Big week for US data and the Fed
items.summary: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh was due to speak on Monday and the October FOMC minutes come out on Wednesday. Yahoo Finance's quote bar showed the US 10-year yield at 5.13% before the open (5.15% at Friday's close).
items.source: Reuters via CNBC Africa, 16 Nov 2026 08:56 GMT; Yahoo Finance live blog, 16 Nov 2026 06:25 PST; LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ^TNX), close 13 Nov 2026

items.title: Telkom +15.1% at R71.35, MTN -2.3% at R229.16 on takeover talks
items.summary: Quotes at 14:54-14:56 SAST. Telkom touched R73.30, a 52-week high, and was valued at about R36.5bn. The state owns 40.5% of Telkom, so selling its stake would need political backing, and any deal would need approval from the competition authorities and Icasa. Talks are at an early stage and a deal is not certain. Telkom reports interim results on Tuesday.

items.title: JSE All Share 111,800 at 14:15, 0.5% below Friday
items.summary: The Top 40 was at 103,838 (-0.6%), held back by miners. Closing levels were not yet available to LRC this run.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ^J203.JO, ^J200.JO), 16 Nov 2026 14:15 SAST

items.title: CPI on Wednesday, SARB on Thursday
items.summary: A Reuters poll expects October CPI at 5.1%, up from 4.5% in September; the repo rate is 7.25%. The 2035 government bond yield rose 1.5 basis points to 8.545% in early trade.
items.source: Reuters via CNBC Africa, 16 Nov 2026 08:56 GMT; LRC Market Dashboard, 13 Nov 2026

items.title: Rand near R17/$ as the dollar rises for a fifth day
items.summary: The rand was at R16.99/$ at 08:33 SAST and R16.94/$ at 14:15 SAST, against R16.76/$ at Friday's close. The euro was at $1.1014, from $1.1029.
items.source: Reuters via CNBC Africa, 16 Nov 2026 08:56 GMT; LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ZAR=X), 13 and 16 Nov 2026; AP via BNN Bloomberg, 16 Nov 2026

items.title: Gold about $3,869, Brent about $95
items.summary: Gold was at $3,869.00 (-0.45%) on Yahoo Finance's quote bar around the US pre-open, near its lowest since October 2025. Brent was at $95.55 (-0.3%) in the morning; reports point to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz nearing pre-war levels, against new attacks in the region.
items.source: Yahoo Finance live blog, 16 Nov 2026 06:25 PST; AP via BNN Bloomberg, 16 Nov 2026 06:48 EST

items.title: Nvidia: $158.70 in early trade, well below our $262.56 fair value
items.summary: The fall is about the leadership change and talk of Huang's return, not new business figures; Tuesday's results are the next real test (analysts expect revenue up 91% to $108.93bn, per TipRanks). CLSA cut its target to $225 from $425. Our BUY rating is unchanged.
items.source: City AM, 16 Nov 2026 14:38 GMT; TipRanks, 16 Nov 2026; LRC Watchlist

items.title: AMD down 5.1% at the open after an 8.8% fall on Friday
items.summary: AMD is falling with the chip group. Our SELL rating is unchanged.
items.source: City AM, 16 Nov 2026 14:38 GMT; AP via BNN Bloomberg, 16 Nov 2026
